title: Replay the packet-3410 bypass and bound funded owner restoration
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Packet 3410 is the sole omission outside #8000’s test. The literal funded bypass preserves 679 of 680 forward outputs. The changed 680-owner word loses owner 679 and the valid 679-owner projection has signed BIT margin about `−178.53128122` at `0.00388`. Funded fresh independent owner rebinds fail with retained old payload components: `28,101` single receipts and `26,640` pairs. Three extra receipts exceed budget.

## Task and overlap

Refined #7852 follow-up on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, toolkit `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, and native comparator #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. Source #8000 `75d78d5877e522284197b782b1b8db237d18af58` establishes the directed cut scope. The package distinguishes four-ingress frozen-axis collision witnesses from loosened owner endpoint/receipt checks and independently replayed Pro consultations.

## Validation

Four cold package replays checked both orientations, full price, exact physical restoring and damaged controls, `524` input collisions, 11-fixed- and 3-fixed-equation clocked cuts, whole-word two-coordinate perturbations under retiming, and `4,096` exact paired masks.

## Open next questions

Allow changed old packet components or other incidences. With native clocks, the identified 1931/1934 opening must still address x679 leakage through 1932/2470 and preserve all older demanded rows. A legal full operator is required before admission.
